# pre-post

> Visual diff tool for pull requests — one command captures before/after screenshots of every route your branch changed.

## Links

- [Homepage](https://site-puce-rho.vercel.app): Overview, install instructions, usage examples
- [GitHub](https://github.com/juangadm/pre-post): Source code and issues
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@juangadm/pre-post): Package registry

## What it does

pre-post detects the routes your branch changed, captures them on production ("Pre") and on your dev server ("Post") at desktop and mobile in 2x retina quality, pixel-diffs each pair, and posts a single comment on the pull request that a reviewer can judge at a glance.

## How it works

1. Make your UI changes
2. Say `/pre-post` in Claude Code, or run `pre-post pr`
3. pre-post diffs your branch against main, then follows the import graph to every route you touched
4. It captures each route twice — production (Pre) and your dev server (Post), desktop and mobile
5. It pixel-diffs each pair and crops the changed region
6. One sticky comment lands on the PR, updated in place on every run

## Install

Nothing to install. The first run downloads the CLI and the Chromium headless shell. Needs Node 20+ and a GitHub token (`gh auth login` or `GH_TOKEN`).

```
npx -y @juangadm/pre-post@latest pr
```

## Add as a Claude Code Skill

```
npx skills add juangadm/pre-post -y
```

## Key features

- Automatic route detection from the git diff, following the import graph
- Next.js App Router, Next.js Pages Router, Vite, and monorepos
- Desktop and mobile screenshots at 2x retina, captured concurrently
- Pixel diff with change percentage, bounding box, highlight, and a tight crop
- Deterministic captures — frozen clock, finished animations, settled fonts and layout
- One sticky PR comment, updated in place on every run
- Images published to a `pre-post-assets` branch, so no CI is triggered and private repos render
- Ad-hoc modes: compare two URLs, diff two PNGs, detect routes, sign in to protected sites

## Built on

Fork of Vercel Labs' before-and-after by James Clements. pre-post adds automatic route detection, a pixel diff, image publishing, and the sticky PR comment behind a single command.
